main_text.p: Hispania, qui in Palcha sabbatho ad baptizandum fponte repleri folent, non in Hispanorum, sed Francorum Pafchate repleri fuerint. Pela- Polyd. Virg. ... [illegible, ~6 letters] II, qui confenfum imperatoris, quod Romanorum a Longobardis obfefla fuiffet, petere non debuit ut Subdiaconi vel uxores a fepararent, facerdotiorum pofleffione cederent, confiturit, & quotidianam sacramentorum praefationem ad Miflas, novem tantummodo praefationibus, fecundum antiquum Romanorum or dinem effe commutandam, decrevit. Sub eo in Toletana Arrianorum Synodo ut, qui ex Catholicis ad Arrianos defecerunt, manuum tantum impositione, absque ullo baptismo, in communionem, cum hac verborum formula, fi dent gloriam Patri per Filium in Spiritu Sancto, recipiantur, decretum eft. Chilpericus, Praetextati Epifcopi Rothomagenfis, qui partes Merovaei rebellantis foverat, cauturus judicaturus, Synodum Epifcoporum convocavit, in qua Turonenfis ad Regem dixit:

p.i: Si quis de nobis, o Rex, juffitis tramitem tranfcendere voluerit, a te corrigi poteft.

page.notes: Page is a scan of a 16th-century Latin theological text with an ornament; marginal notes at the sides are partly illegible and are only approximated. Several words in the running text are damaged and uncertain.
